identity_evidence_independence_rationale: Al-Mizzi's biographical entry gives the matching full lineage (خلف بن محمد بن عيسى بن أبي عبد الله), kunyah (أبو الحسين), occupational nisbah (الخشاب القافلاني), regional nisbah (الواسطي), sobriquet (كردوس), Sunan Ibn Majah transmission (ق), and precise death chronology (mid-Dhu al-Hijjah 274 AH at Wasit, aged >80). This decision uses convergent biographical details only, excluding the evaluative grade. Note on source dependence: Because Ibn Hajar drew substantially upon al-Mizzi's Tahdhib al-Kamal in compiling Taqrib al-Tahdhib, this correspondence reflects literary compilation dependence rather than multiple independent historical attestations.
